http/internal/http2_output#

The single writer of an HTTP/2 connection: a bounded queue of frame groups, each written whole and in order.

Version: v1.0.0

Description#

The single writer of an HTTP/2 connection: a bounded queue of frame groups, each written whole and in order.

Internal to the http modules; programs do not import it.

Public API#

role Http2OutputStarting

Told when a queued group starts to be written.

The group started.

object Http2ConnectionOutput#

object Http2ConnectionOutput does Http2ControlQueuing

Connection owns run(); stream callers own only tickets. Cancelling a ticket never cancels a started physical frame or splits a HEADERS/CONTINUATION block.

Writes to origin, queuing at most maximum groups and byte_limit bytes.
